synthesis_scope.method: Text-only synthesis of existing completed review reports and the written reference scope.
synthesis_scope.note: Text synthesis is complete for all 76 main reports and the targeted coordinator report. The main reports collectively list 454 required cases. The targeted follow-up, prior-closure recheck, and SUP39 retry add no required main case. This completion does not assert a clean round, runtime acceptance, or independent image inspection by the synthesizer.
synthesis_scope.scope_triage: The latest coordinating scope accepts honestly disabled unintegrated business/firmware capability states with accurate visible unavailable feedback. Open actions are limited to actual UI structure, clarity, empty states, real data presentation, containment, and reachability.
synthesis_scope.raw_item_counting: active_source_suggestions counts the 86 items in main/targeted suggestions arrays, including optional-tagged and accepted items. One separately stored optional observation and one separately stored capture finding add source review items. Four withdrawn items and one named structured coverage item are tracked in the full source-ID ledger without inflating the active suggestion count.

groups.description: Page-jump surfaces draw their top separator inside the page grid.
groups.evidence_summary: Paperwhite and Scribe library reports place a separator inside page-button rows instead of at the surface top. Paperwhite ToC and Scribe portrait/landscape ToC pickers reproduce it with expanded grids. In Scribe portrait the rule crosses the first row near y854; in landscape it crosses near y545 while the heading is near y468. The reports consistently distinguish this rule from the required top boundary.
groups.recommended_action: Measure the complete jump surface from its title, padding, and every grid row, keep its white interior opaque, and anchor the 2 px rule above the title at the actual top edge. Cover any stale underlying separator while preserving the balanced grid, folio, and navigation allocations.

groups.description: Library More menus use incomplete or incorrect action icons.
groups.evidence_summary: Both reports describe a standalone multiselect check in place of the reference checked square. The Scribe report additionally describes a bulleted-list glyph where the category-management row should have a folder outline; popup geometry and labels remain aligned.
groups.recommended_action: Use the checked-square multiselect icon and the folder-outline category icon in their existing monochrome slots without changing row alignment.

groups.description: Paperwhite library filter-chip labels and widths are smaller than the reference.
groups.evidence_summary: The source report estimates 14 px labels and 81 px chip widths versus approximately 16 px and 86 px in the normalized reference. The four-chip row ends about 20 px early while its height and surrounding sort geometry remain intact.
groups.recommended_action: Match the reference label size and chip widths while retaining the approximately 44 px height and clear spacing.

groups.description: Source update rows omit the installed-to-available version transition.
groups.evidence_summary: The Paperwhite report shows installed versions only; the Scribe report shows target versions only. Both report that the same captured state contains installed v12/v8 and available v13/v9, so the complete transition can be displayed from real records.
groups.recommended_action: Build each update subtitle from matching installed and available source records and display both versions with an arrow while preserving existing update controls and profile geometry.

groups.description: Active incognito status strips omit the centered no-history policy notice.
groups.evidence_summary: Paperwhite and Scribe reference reviews describe an inverted strip whose center is empty despite an active incognito preference. Supplemental reports reproduce the omission on both profiles after navigation and persistence, including detail routes without a history-page toggle. The issue concerns normal application pages; the closed-reader artwork-only exception remains explicit.
groups.recommended_action: Render a concise centered incognito/no-history notice whenever incognito mode is active on normal application pages, including restored sessions. Preserve clock/device indicators and the artwork-only closed-reader exception.

groups.description: The Paperwhite description body lacks the specified first-line indent and line spacing.
groups.evidence_summary: The revised report retains only this independently specified typography discrepancy: candidate lines are reported about 26 px apart with an unindented first line, versus the prototype's 18/32 body and two-em indent. No clipping or functional loss is reported.
groups.recommended_action: Apply the two-em first-line indent and approximately 32 px line height while preserving content margins and content-driven sheet height.

groups.description: Enabled Paperwhite contrast controls lose their reference emphasis.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes pale minus/plus outlines and a regular-weight Standard label instead of black outlines and a bold value. The recorded contrast value is not at an endpoint.
groups.recommended_action: Use black outlines for enabled contrast step buttons and the reference bold value treatment.

groups.description: All three reading-mode panels omit the reference slot for the independent wide-page splitting control.
groups.evidence_summary: The original reports describe a missing row beneath crop borders on Paperwhite and an empty corresponding area beside crop borders in Scribe portrait and landscape. These observations establish missing structure; the latest scope accepts unintegrated splitting behavior when it is honestly unavailable.
groups.recommended_action: Restore the independently labeled splitting-control slot and reference spacing in each reading-mode panel. While splitting is not integrated, show the control disabled with a concise accurate unavailable explanation. Do not present an enabled or successful state without real behavior.
groups.grouping_note: This group concerns the missing reading-mode slot. G20 retains the distinct missing Layout structure; the Settings capability limitation formerly grouped there is accepted as P3R1-A01.

source_observations.description: Restore the separate split-double-page-spreads control in the PW reading-mode panel.
source_observations.evidence: The reference has a dedicated switch row below crop borders at approximately logical y=581-635. The candidate ends the mode controls after crop borders, and the expected state explicitly requires crop and split controls. This software control is not covered by the declared hardware capability bounds.
source_observations.recommendation: Expose a reachable split-double-page-spreads switch beneath crop borders, backed by the actual reader preference, and retain the reference row spacing without clipping the progress section.

source_observations.description: The Scribe landscape reading-mode panel omits the independent cross-page-image splitting control.
source_observations.evidence: After normalization to logical scale, the reference contains a labeled splitting toggle in the right half below the four direction cards, approximately x644-1120 and y657-719. The same candidate region is blank while the left crop-borders toggle remains visible. The assigned expected state explicitly requires crop and split controls, and this case has no applicable capability exclusion.
source_observations.recommendation: Restore an independently labeled and operable cross-page-image splitting toggle beside crop borders, showing its real current preference and preserving the two-column row.

source_observations.description: The Scribe reading-mode sheet omits the required split-wide-page toggle.
source_observations.evidence: The candidate shows four direction cards and a crop-borders toggle at the lower left, with the entire lower-right control area empty. At the same logical scale, the reference places the split-cross-page-image label and toggle in that lower-right area. The supplied expected state explicitly requires crop and split controls, and this software control has no stated hardware exclusion.
source_observations.recommendation: Restore the split-wide-page control beside crop borders in the Scribe reading-mode sheet, with its current state visibly represented and an accessible interaction target.

groups.triage_note: Open for missing structure and truthful availability presentation only. Implementing wide-image splitting is not required by this review.

groups.description: Paperwhite manual orientation omits reverse landscape.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes only Portrait and Landscape cards, corroborated by the recorded modal item IDs. The reference and expected state require a third manual reverse-landscape choice; sensor absence does not exclude it.
groups.recommended_action: Implement and expose a real reverse-landscape state with the third enabled card and reference three-column geometry.

groups.description: Reading-mode title rows omit the current book's stored default-direction hint.
groups.evidence_summary: Both reports describe an empty supporting-text area where the reference displays the book default, despite recorded right-to-left state and an enabled remember-book-direction preference.
groups.recommended_action: Show the actual stored book-default direction with the reference subdued, right-aligned supporting-text treatment.

groups.description: The Paperwhite power page adds excess vertical space before the screensaver preview grid.
groups.evidence_summary: The report identifies an approximately 8.5 px localized excess gap after an otherwise matching policy-row divider. Preview heights and horizontal dimensions match, and the explicit prototype gap and label tokens support the retained observation.
groups.recommended_action: Match the 10 px main gap and 8 px label top margin with the appropriate 12 px line box while retaining the existing 150 px preview heights.

groups.description: Empty source preferences fail to produce a contained, recognizable source-settings state.
groups.evidence_summary: For an empty source_preference_groups array, the Paperwhite report describes no visible settings change or dismissal action. The Scribe report describes a title, Done action, and empty message without the white outlined popover, exposing them against catalog controls.
groups.recommended_action: Always render a white outlined source-settings container with source identity, a truthful empty-state message, appropriate internal padding, and a reachable Done/Close action. Size it to actual content and never fabricate preferences.

groups.description: The blocked-source recovery state omits its direct migration action.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes Source management and Uninstall without the reference migration action, while the captured state records migration_available=true.
groups.recommended_action: Expose a direct action into the real migration flow. Where no migratable entries exist, show an accurate disabled state or explanation while retaining source switching and uninstall.

groups.description: Scribe server-setup actions have unequal widths.
groups.evidence_summary: The report estimates a 359/269 px split where the reference uses two approximately 314 px actions, with no clipping pressure or meaningful label-length difference.
groups.recommended_action: Give phone entry and test/connect equal flexible widths within the current form, retaining the existing gap, height, and truthful enabled or disabled state.

groups.description: The source picker truncates the distinguishing server connection state.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes Komga, Kavita, and Suwayomi showing the same generic category prefix and ellipsis, although the captured state distinguishes connected from unconfigured servers. The paired reference keeps those states readable.
groups.recommended_action: Reserve a compact area for the complete actual connection/configuration state, truncating a generic category prefix first if needed.

groups.description: The Scribe queue panel border does not enclose its pagination.
groups.evidence_summary: The reference review describes side borders stopping near y729 while the folio is below them near y765. Supplemental cancel and three-row operational frames reproduce this. A two-row final page also stops the outline near y622 with the folio near y656, so varying job counts do not remove the containment defect.
groups.recommended_action: Include header, actual rows, pagination, and bottom padding in one content-sized white queue panel with a continuous four-sided outline on first and last pages and operation variants.

groups.description: The Scribe category-strip baseline has gaps beneath inactive tabs.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes white breaks in the thin gray divider beneath inactive tab cells, while the reference keeps a continuous baseline under the active underline.
groups.recommended_action: Draw the shared divider after inactive tab backgrounds or confine those backgrounds above it, preserving tab geometry and the active underline.

groups.description: The manga More menu omits Delete all downloads when downloads exist.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes four menu rows where the reference has a fifth deletion row. Recorded modal items omit deletion even though downloaded_count=9.
groups.recommended_action: Expose the contextual deletion action for the current book and connect it to the actual operation and required confirmation. If unavailable, retain a clearly disabled action with an accurate reason.
groups.grouping_note: The missing action is independent of the menu's missing icon slot and text gutter.

groups.description: The manga More menu omits leading action icons and shifts its text gutter left.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes text-only rows starting around logical x588 where the reference has icon slots and labels around x626. It records an approximately 38 px gutter shift, separately from the missing deletion row.
groups.recommended_action: Restore consistent monochrome leading icons and the reference label gutter while retaining truthful gray unavailable states.

source_observations.description: Restore the leading action icons and matching text gutter in the manga More menu.
source_observations.evidence: All candidate menu rows are text-only and begin around logical x=588. The reference places the refresh, migration, folder, screensaver, and deletion icons at that location and starts labels around x=626. The candidate therefore loses the reference's action iconography and shifts all row labels left by approximately 38 logical pixels.
source_observations.recommendation: Render the corresponding monochrome action icon in a consistent leading slot and align row labels with the reference gutter, while preserving the explicit gray unavailable state where applicable.

priority_adjustment.basis: Pure visual fidelity priority. All reported observations and corrective actions are retained; no broader structural, readability, or functional loss is inferred.

groups.description: The landscape Layout sheet omits separate-cover and whole/split-spread control structure.
groups.evidence_summary: The original Layout report describes both control groups absent from the right column, with only the Single, Double, and Automatic page-layout items recorded. The Settings reports formerly grouped here instead show gray controls plus a visible unavailable label; those observations are preserved and accepted separately as P3R1-A01.
groups.recommended_action: Restore labeled separate-cover and whole/split-spread control slots in the landscape Layout sheet. Show them disabled with a concise accurate unavailable explanation while the behaviors are not integrated, or reflect real state if a behavior exists. Preserve access alongside the three page-layout cards without implying successful unsupported behavior.

source_observations.description: The landscape Layout sheet omits the Separate cover page toggle and the Whole page / Split into two spread-image controls.
source_observations.evidence: At the same 1240 by 930 logical scale, the candidate's right column around x697-1120 and y596-705 is blank. The reference places the separate-cover toggle and spread-image treatment choices there. The candidate sidecar exposes only the Single, Double, and Automatic layout items. The missing controls are not excluded by the supplied capability boundaries.
source_observations.recommendation: Restore the separate-cover toggle and the whole/split spread-image choices in the landscape Layout sheet, showing their current state and keeping both groups fully accessible alongside the three page-layout cards.

source_observations.description: The required whole/split-spread and separate-cover preferences are unavailable.
source_observations.evidence: In the candidate's lower form, both Whole page and Split into two pages are gray and unselected, the separate-cover switch is gray and off, and the spread-image section explicitly says Unavailable. The reference provides enabled controls with a selected whole-page state and an enabled separate-cover switch. The case has no intentional difference declaring these software preferences out of scope, and the declared pen/hardware/auth capability bounds do not apply to them.
source_observations.recommendation: Implement persistent whole-versus-split spread handling and the separate-cover preference, then expose enabled controls with the same clear selected-state treatment as the reference. Keep the current honest unavailable presentation until those behaviors exist.

source_observations.description: Wide-image handling and cover-alone preferences are presented as unavailable.
evidence: The candidate visibly mutes both whole-page/split choices and the cover-alone switch; the wide-image group is labeled unavailable.
HANDOFF.md section 5.7, line 295, and prototype/sc-settings.dc.html lines 326-329 require landscape behavior, whole-page versus split-wide-image handling, and a cover-alone switch.
These image-layout preferences are software behavior and are not covered by the accepted missing hardware or third-party integration differences.
source_observations.recommendation: Implement and persist the wide-image and cover-alone preferences, connect them to real reader layout behavior, and present their controls as ordinary enabled choices with truthful selection state.

groups.triage_note: Open only for absent Layout structure. Existing honest Settings capability presentation does not require backend expansion.

groups.description: The Scribe landscape orientation card does not communicate landscape spread.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes a generic Landscape label and single-page rectangle where the reference uses Landscape spread with a two-page icon. Captured state already records spread=true, so the observation concerns the affordance rather than demonstrated runtime behavior.
groups.recommended_action: Use the landscape-spread label and divided two-page icon for the Scribe landscape action.

groups.description: Search result-card captions use serif rather than interface sans-serif typography.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes serif stroke contrast and terminals in all visible result captions beneath MangaDex and Komga covers, unlike the reference UI glyphs. It distinguishes this from the intentionally serif editing-state local-match heading.
groups.recommended_action: Apply the reference sans-serif family and approximately 16 px caption weight to result cards while retaining the existing caption geometry and editing-state heading style.

source_observations.description: Use the reference interface sans-serif typography for result-card captions.
source_observations.evidence: All visible Chinese titles below MangaDex and Komga covers have pronounced serif stroke contrast and terminals in the candidate. Their reference counterparts use sans-serif UI glyphs. The editing-state local-match heading intentionally uses serif typography, so this discrepancy is specific to the result-card caption style.
source_observations.recommendation: Apply the reference UI sans-serif family and matching approximately 16px caption weight to the result cards, while preserving the editing-state local-match title styling and the current caption geometry.

priority_adjustment.basis: Pure visual fidelity priority. All reported observations and corrective actions are retained; no broader structural, readability, or functional loss is inferred.

groups.description: The failed-source Retry control is wider than the reference.
groups.evidence_summary: The report estimates an 88 px candidate width versus approximately 74 px in the normalized reference, with matching short labels, 44 px height, and aligned right edge.
groups.recommended_action: Use the reference width or equivalent horizontal padding while retaining height and right alignment.

groups.description: Unavailable category creation and renaming lack explicit action and capability presentation.
groups.evidence_summary: The Scribe report describes missing disabled Rename affordances and counts occupying their trailing space. Paperwhite reports describe disabled New category and static category rows without visible unavailable status. The captured rows are disabled; the observations do not require simulated success.
groups.recommended_action: Show a concise unavailable status for creation and renaming and retain appropriate disabled Rename and New category affordances. Keep actual counts, place counts before trailing actions, and preserve immutable Uncategorized. Implement real operations only if included in the product scope.

groups.description: Disabled logging settings omit the recorded visible unavailable feedback.
groups.evidence_summary: Both profile reports describe disabled log controls and no visible explanation, although settings_status contains an unavailable message. The absence of that user-visible status remains actionable; the original request to implement logging operations is superseded by the latest scope.
groups.recommended_action: Display the actual unavailable status and a concise reason where known beside the logging controls. Keep unsupported controls honestly disabled. Real logging integration may enable them later, but it is not required to resolve this feedback issue.

source_observations.description: The applicable logging section exposes only unavailable controls and omits the visible operation status.
source_observations.evidence: The candidate log-file toggle, export action, and clear action all use disabled gray styling. The sidecar settings_status records an unavailable state, while the screenshot contains no visible explanation. The reference has an enabled log toggle and reachable export and clear buttons. This case has no logging capability bound or intentional exception.
source_observations.recommendation: Connect log writing, export, and clear to actual logging operations and keep supported actions reachable. Render the real operation result or unavailable reason in the section so the user can understand the current state; do not enable placeholder actions.

source_observations.description: The logging secondary page offers only disabled controls and does not display its recorded unavailable status or explain the current limitation.
evidence: The candidate shows a disabled logfile switch and disabled Export logs and Clear logs buttons, with no inline status text anywhere below the title.
case_metadata.state.settings_status contains a nonempty unavailable message.
phase3-reference-scope.json precedence.real-state and sharedContract.behavior require truthful operation states; the status is available in the evidence but absent from the user-visible page.
source_observations.recommendation: Render the actual unavailable status beside or above the disabled logging actions and include a concise reason where known, so users can understand the current feature state.

groups.triage_note: Open for missing visible feedback only. Do not implement or simulate a logging backend merely to match the reference's enabled examples.

groups.description: Disabled charging-update and reading-time Wi-Fi rows lack a visible unavailable explanation.
groups.evidence_summary: The targeted coordinator report confirms that the visible Unavailable label is beside the screensaver heading and applies only to its three disabled cards. The separate charging-update and reading-time Wi-Fi rows above it are disabled without visible explanation. This resolves the prior explanation-scope uncertainty while preserving the accepted screensaver limitation in A02.
groups.recommended_action: Add a concise accurate unavailable explanation that clearly applies to each unsupported upper policy or to their shared group. Preserve honest disabled controls and the existing screensaver limitation. No unintegrated firmware or background policy implementation is required.

source_observations.description: Required update, Wi-Fi, and screensaver policies remain unavailable in the power section.
source_observations.evidence: The candidate charging-update and reading-time Wi-Fi switches are disabled. The current-cover, reading-progress, and system-default screensaver cards are all disabled and have no selected state; an unavailable label is shown. The reference exposes these policies and a selected screensaver. The case metadata declares no capability bound or intentional exception for these controls.
source_observations.recommendation: Implement the actual supported charging-update, Wi-Fi, and screensaver policy operations, persist their settings, and reflect the real current selection. Keep the existing reachable keep-awake and exit actions. Any genuine target limitation should have explicit capability evidence and a visible explanation rather than unconditional disabled placeholders.

groups.triage_note: Confirmed UI clarity issue only. The coordinator reviewed the original candidate and reference and recorded their SHA256 identities; this synthesis carries that report as attributed evidence and did not open images.

priority_adjustment.basis: The open scope is the absent explanation for disabled upper policies, not missing policy backend implementation.

scope_confirmation.observed: The screensaver label is section-specific; charging-update and reading-time Wi-Fi have no visible unavailable explanation.

groups.description: Scribe logging action buttons are narrower than the reference.
groups.evidence_summary: The report estimates approximately 100 px per button versus 118 px in the normalized reference and explicitly distinguishes the geometry difference from disabled operation state.
groups.recommended_action: Restore the reference horizontal padding or minimum width while retaining left alignment and inter-button spacing.

groups.description: Storage settings omit the four-part usage presentation and largest-storage management section.
groups.evidence_summary: Both profile reports describe only download/cache/free text and cleanup buttons, with no separate cover usage, stacked usage bar and legend, or largest-book rows/explicit empty state. Actual zero or unknown totals do not account for the missing structure.
groups.recommended_action: Render download, cache, cover, and free totals from maintained real data with the usage visualization. Add real largest-storage records and targeted actions or a concise empty state, preserving cleanup and avoiding normal-projection filesystem scans.

groups.description: The shared Scribe device header truncates its capability summary before orientation is readable.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes the same ellipsized capability line across all four assigned settings cases. The reference fits its full summary before the status divider; actual wording may differ but essential capability information is incomplete.
groups.recommended_action: Use concise truthful capability labels or rebalance header text width so the complete summary fits alongside the existing status column.

groups.description: Muted L-shaped and swipe-only layout cards lack an explicit truthful availability explanation.
groups.evidence_summary: The original reports describe gray labels, indicators, and diagrams for the two alternatives and contrast that with the enabled reference examples. That visual observation is retained, but gray appearance alone is not a requirement to enable unintegrated mappings.
groups.recommended_action: Keep the reference card structure and make the alternatives' actual availability clear. If unsupported, retain disabled styling with a concise accurate reason; if a real mapping is implemented, show its actual selectable and persistent state. Do not use normal enabled black styling merely to imply a working layout.

source_observations.description: The unselected tap-layout cards have disabled-looking foreground contrast instead of the normal black treatment shown by the reference.
source_observations.evidence: At approximately logical y=298-426, the L-shaped and swipe-only cards have light-gray labels, radio outlines, and diagrams. At the same logical positions, the reference uses black labels and strokes for both unselected cards. This case has no declared capability bound or intentional difference for these alternatives.
source_observations.recommendation: Render selectable unselected tap-layout cards with the reference's normal black foreground and diagram strokes. If either alternative is genuinely unavailable, explicitly document that capability bound and its unavailable state rather than leaving the contrast difference unexplained.

source_observations.description: The L-shaped and swipe-only touch layouts are presented as disabled alternatives.
evidence: The two alternative cards use muted labels, indicators, diagrams, and borders, in contrast with the normal black off-state switches below them.

HANDOFF.md section 5.7, line 293, and prototype/sc-settings.dc.html lines 318-320 specify three selectable layouts: three-region, L-shaped, and swipe-only, followed by inversion and zone-display preferences.
These touch layouts do not depend on unavailable device hardware or external authorization.
source_observations.recommendation: Provide real selectable and persistent L-shaped and swipe-only layouts, apply their mappings to reader input, and render their unselected cards with the normal enabled styling.

groups.triage_note: Open for clarity and structure only. Real L-shaped/swipe mappings are an optional implementation choice and are not mandated by this review.

groups.description: The narrow installed-source row truncates its explicit unavailable status.
groups.evidence_summary: The reference source-manager report and supplemental language/boundary frames describe the blocked subtitle ellipsizing after browser-verification wording before its explicit unavailable clause. Scribe 3 reproduces the same projection in its native stretched viewport. available=false and the full reason are recorded; warning styling and Uninstall remain visible. This remains a status-readability issue and does not require enabling the source.
groups.recommended_action: Shorten the reason or reserve a concise visible unavailable segment before optional detail inside the 400 px installed column. Preserve the truthful browser-verification limitation, warning tile, and Uninstall action.

priority_normalization.basis: The coordinator retains the existing shared P3 readability classification. The later raw P2 recurrence does not establish a new, broader functional defect.

groups.description: Catalog include/exclude tags use plus/minus instead of the specified check/cross marks across profiles.
groups.evidence_summary: The Paperwhite report records plus/minus prefixes for included and excluded Adventure. Scribe supplemental reports independently record the same glyph mismatch. Selected black surfaces and dashed/struck exclusion remain distinguishable, so these are marker-fidelity observations.
groups.recommended_action: Use check and cross prefixes across profiles while retaining tri-state behavior, real counts, inverse inclusion, and dashed/struck-through exclusion.

groups.description: Dense tag collections truncate the text needed to distinguish actual filter and summary tags.
groups.evidence_summary: Paperwhite first, second, and final filter pages collapse distinct numbered tags or included labels to common prefixes. Scribe reports the same loss across all three filter pages and the summary's visible tag collection, with 34 distinct tag identities retained in case data.
groups.recommended_action: Reflow or resize tag controls, use fewer columns or additional pages, and preserve each short distinguishing suffix plus its include/exclude marker. Let short final pages use available width. Keep this identity issue distinct from labels painting outside detail chip outlines in G40.

groups.description: Description pagination splits English words at page boundaries.
groups.evidence_summary: The report records one page ending with the first letter of provider and the following page starting with its remaining letters. It explicitly does not assert lost text.
groups.recommended_action: Prefer word or paragraph boundaries while preserving every character and content-driven final-sheet height.

groups.description: View all hides settled source results behind an inconsistent setup gate.
groups.evidence_summary: The Paperwhite report describes a blank catalog despite 40 recorded results and pagination. The Scribe report describes a setup form with no cards or folio despite 40 results and ten visible_catalog records in state. Both record source_needs_setup=true. A separate Scribe server-connect frame does display a populated catalog, so the observation is specific to the View-all flow rather than a global rendering failure.
groups.recommended_action: Reconcile setup state with the actual fetched catalog when entering from View all and present returned records with pagination. If setup genuinely prevents their use, show a specific truthful reason and usable recovery action without fabricating a verified connection or needlessly requiring repeated setup.

groups.description: Offline/demo library refresh reports Saved instead of the actual update-check outcome.
groups.evidence_summary: The Paperwhite report describes a Saved toast in the demo/offline branch that returns before an update check or save. The Scribe report reproduces the unrelated Saved acknowledgement with offline=true and busy=false, noting that its mechanical check accepts any nonempty message rather than validating refresh semantics.
groups.recommended_action: Show explicit offline/demo feedback when updates were not checked. For real requests, show checking only while actual work runs and then the actual completion/error result. Preserve the compact outlined toast without fabricated success.

groups.description: The download destination is truncated before its identifying directory components.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes a single ellipsized Save location value ending after the shared run-directory prefix. The complete actual path exists in recorded settings data, but its row is disabled and has no full-path action.
groups.recommended_action: Wrap the destination in a dedicated multiline value area or provide a visible full-path detail action on Paperwhite.

groups.description: Add source list uses a solid border instead of the creation-action dashed outline.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes Add source list and Open source management with matching solid outlines, while HANDOFF and static prototype text distinguish dashed creation actions from solid management actions.
groups.recommended_action: Apply the declared white dashed-outline treatment to Add source list and retain the solid management action.

groups.description: Empty Bookmarks tabs provide a blank list without status or a clear next step.
groups.evidence_summary: Paperwhite, Scribe portrait, and Scribe landscape reports describe a selected Bookmarks tab followed by blank white list space, zero bookmark records, and no explanatory status or understandable next step. The header bookmark control exists, but the empty list does not identify it.
groups.recommended_action: Show a concise no-bookmarks status and an understandable next step based on actual state, such as a labeled current-page bookmark action or guidance identifying the existing header control. Retain the content-sized white sheet and undimmed artwork.

groups.description: Scribe detail metadata tags overflow their chip outlines and omit undisclosed values.
groups.evidence_summary: Queue-exposed and content-stress detail reports describe Adventure, Long metadata, and numbered tag labels painting outside narrow boxes and colliding. Real-migration candidate, selected, and committed reports reproduce that containment issue and record five actual tags while only four compressed chips are visible, with no second row or overflow disclosure.
groups.recommended_action: Measure every label plus horizontal padding, wrap the complete chip collection inside the information column with distinct gaps, and let its height follow the rows. Preserve every actual tag or expose an operable overflow disclosure if a limit is intentional; keep oversized text within its own bounds.
groups.grouping_note: This is label containment/overlap in detail chips. G33 separately tracks indistinguishable ellipsized identities in bounded filter and summary tag collections.

groups.description: Installed-source truncation removes the distinguishing suffix from adjacent real configurations.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes the first ten saved sources as the same Configured local fixture 0... prefix with identical tiles/status, although actual names contain distinct 00 and 01 suffixes within 25 configurations.
groups.recommended_action: Preserve the unique part of long source names through wrapping, additional name allocation, or suffix-preserving truncation while retaining truthful connection status in the installed column.

groups.description: The Scribe description pager extends below the floating summary outline.
groups.evidence_summary: The report describes final-page side rules ending near y739 while the 3/3 folio is near y774 on a white strip extending to roughly y807 with no closing bottom rule. The taller first page also leaves its description-pagination region unframed.
groups.recommended_action: Include description pagination and its padding inside the panel's measured content height and draw continuous side and bottom rules around the complete white surface, allowing short final pages to shrink to content.
groups.grouping_note: The queue outline is a related symptom on a different panel, with no established shared implementation root cause. Description word-boundary pagination remains an independent issue.

groups.description: The empty-history body provides a status without a direct next action.
groups.evidence_summary: The empty-history and clear-apply reports both describe a clock icon and status heading with no nearby action. The clear endpoint records zero history, no modal, and a 1/1 folio. The global dock remains usable, but HANDOFF explicitly requires status plus an action in the empty component.
groups.recommended_action: Add one concise real Library or Browse route action beneath the empty-history status, retaining centered monochrome presentation without explanatory body copy.

groups.description: The fourth searched source has no visible scope entry or overflow affordance.
